import FreeCAD as App
import Part

# Mounting plate: X -30..30 (60mm), Y -20..20 (40mm), Z 0..5 (5mm)
plate = Part.makeBox(60, 40, 5, App.Vector(-30, -20, 0), App.Vector(0, 0, 1))

# Four 4mm diameter (r=2mm) through holes along Z at (±25, ±15)
hole_positions = [(25, 15), (-25, 15), (25, -15), (-25, -15)]
holes = []
for x, y in hole_positions:
    # extend beyond plate in Z to ensure clean cut (from -1 to 9, plate is 0..5)
    cyl = Part.makeCylinder(2, 10, App.Vector(x, y, -1), App.Vector(0, 0, 1))
    holes.append(cyl)

result = plate
for h in holes:
    result = result.cut(h)

# ensure valid solid
result = result.removeSplitter()

import FreeCAD as App
import Part

# Plate 40x20x4
plate = Part.makeBox(40, 20, 4, App.Vector(0, 0, 0), App.Vector(0, 0, 1))

# Boss diameter 10 (r=5), Z 4 to 14 (h=10) at (10,10)
boss = Part.makeCylinder(5, 10, App.Vector(10, 10, 4), App.Vector(0, 0, 1), 360)

# Base solid
base = plate.fuse(boss)
base = base.removeSplitter()

# Hole 3mm diameter (r=1.5) along Z through boss and plate, extended beyond for clean cut
holeTool = Part.makeCylinder(1.5, 20, App.Vector(10, 10, -1), App.Vector(0, 0, 1), 360)

# Slot obround 16 long overall, 6 wide, long side along Y, centred at (28,10), through plate along Z
# width 6 => radius 3, overall length 16 => straight length = 16-6 =10
# rectangle 6 (X) x 10 (Y) from (25,5) to (31,15), plus two end cylinders r=3 at (28,5) and (28,15)
slot_rect = Part.makeBox(6, 10, 20, App.Vector(25, 5, -1), App.Vector(0, 0, 1))
slot_cyl1 = Part.makeCylinder(3, 20, App.Vector(28, 5, -1), App.Vector(0, 0, 1), 360)
slot_cyl2 = Part.makeCylinder(3, 20, App.Vector(28, 15, -1), App.Vector(0, 0, 1), 360)
slotTool = slot_rect.fuse(slot_cyl1).fuse(slot_cyl2)
slotTool = slotTool.removeSplitter()

# Cuts
result = base.cut(holeTool)
result = result.cut(slotTool)
result = result.removeSplitter()
